It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Denver Broncos +1.4 with a fair total of 44.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Denver Broncos pass offence vs Jacksonville Jaguars pass defence, which sits −0.126 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
